cross_cutting_findings.observation: Core2 truthfully renders 'Owner-supplied question, verbatim' and no exam identity, but the learner-facing surface does not disclose that this benchmark input was coordinator/AI-drafted and not personally authored by the owner.
cross_cutting_findings.reason: The pinned OWNER_SUPPLIED metadata vocabulary collapses custody and authorship into one learner label. Issue #33 explicitly says to preserve and evidence this disagreement rather than silently relabel.
cross_cutting_findings.proposed_follow_up: Future custody metadata should separate supplied_by from drafted_by/authorship_claim and allow a non-exam provenance note without weakening OWNER_SUPPLIED wording custody.

cross_cutting_findings.observation: Question help links reach the correct Core1A microtopic but not the unique mapped construction-unit/repair anchor.
cross_cutting_findings.proposed_follow_up: When a question has exactly one mapped construction unit, emit that CU anchor; otherwise fall back to the microtopic.

cross_cutting_findings.observation: The page exposes common wrong routes but does not elicit a discriminating diagnostic before repair, so it cannot establish misconception-versus-slip evidence.
cross_cutting_findings.proposed_follow_up: Offer authored diagnostic probes on demand and log assistance; do not auto-diagnose or infer mastery.

cross_cutting_findings.observation: Core1A provides a meaningful four-stage sigma/pi orbital inventory visualization, but the learner cannot actively assign each orbital to a sigma/pi job with an enforceable one-use-only constraint.
cross_cutting_findings.proposed_follow_up: See builder-proposal.md for a reusable one-to-one allocation interaction.
